messages:
aj_support: Escalating: SolsticeRX trial blocking issue. Provisioning calls to the embeddings endpoint return 403. Trial demo scheduled tomorrow, customer needs a working flow. Marking P1 and handing to CS. :rotating_light:

maria_cs: Thanks AJ. Can you paste the exact error payload and request id? Also confirm this is hosted (no dedicated infra).

aj_support: Hosted. Error: "403 Forbidden - key missing or invalid". Request ID req_a3f9d2. Reproduced after rotating their test key locally. Repro steps below.

aj_support: ```bash
# repro
curl -s -X POST
  -H "Authorization: Bearer test_badkey"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/embeddings
  -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```

maria_cs: Action items: (1) Eng to triage auth/key propagation path, (2) CS to prepare comms + temporary workaround, (3) AE to lock renewal sensitivity and draft extension offer. Nora, can you check contract renewal date and ARR band?

nora_aesales: On it. Renewal in 11 months, but this account is in our high-priority SMB cohort for Q2. If they hit friction during trial, risk of churn increases. I want a 14-day extension offer ready to send if we canast-fail. Also need a short customer note I can send.

kevin_engineering: Ian take debugging. Iound related alerts on auth-service: increased 403 rate around the last deploy window. I'll look at key cache invalidation and the propagate job. ETA for first update: 90m.

sre-bot: Incident created INC-2026-0411-77: auth-service 403 spike. Pager notified.

maria_cs: Proposed comms schedule: 0h ack + suggested workaround (UI token manual ingest) + ETA, 6h technical update, 24h resolution or offer extension + onboarding session. Owners: Eng=Kevin, CS=Maria, AE=Nora, Support=AJ.

aj_support: Workaround sent: asked customer to create a UI token and ingest via the UI path; they confirmed that path works. I told them eng is investigating and we'll update within 2h.

kevin_engineering: Quick update: reproduced the failure pattern. Root cause: race in auth key cache invalidation when keys rotate within a small window; requests landing on certain pods saw stale cache and were rejected. I deployed a fix to canary and bumped the TTL; monitoring for 30m.

maria_cs: Great. If metrics stable for 30m, send customer update that a fix is deployed and ask them to retry demo. If any flakiness remains, proceed with extension offer per plan. Nora, I'll paste the short customer-friendly paragraph below.

nora_aesales: Draft OK, sending to customer once copy finalized. Looping legal for extension approval.

maria_cs: Customer-facing paragraph: "Hi SolsticeRX team 
We discovered an auth cache issue that intermittently rejected newly rotated test keys. Our engineers have deployed a fix and are monitoring. In the meantime you can use the UI token to continue testing (details below). If you see further issues we will extend your trial by 14 days and schedule a dedicated onboarding session. Sorry for the disruption 
- Maria, Customer Success"

kevin_engineering: Canary looks healthy. 403 rate returned to baseline. I'll promote the fix to prod in the next 15m and continue to watch.

sre-bot: Incident INC-2026-0411-77 status: mitigated.

aj_support: Customer confirmed they retried and embeddings succeeded via the original API key after the fix. They appreciate the quick turnaround. Thanks team. :tada:
